# Pagination demo

A small Node library that splits a list into pages.

## Develop

```sh
npm ci
npm test
```

`paginate(items, size)` returns arrays of at most `size` items, preserving their
order. Empty input returns no pages. The size must be a positive integer.

## Reported issue

The final page loses its items when the item count is an exact multiple of the
page size. Fix the bug without changing the public API, preserve the existing
tests, and add regression coverage for a single full page and a page size of one.
